title: Marketplace Africa
description: In South Africa, the next EV opportunity may not be the car, it may be the charger. While the country's electric vehicle market is still small by global standards, the infrastructure needed to support it is becoming a business in its own right. Across the country, companies are now investing in faster public chargers, charging networks and entirely new ways of supplying the electricity needed to keep electric vehicles moving.

title: Marketplace Europe
description: A look behind the scenes at one of the world's top toymakers; meaning "play well" in Danish, Lego was founded in Billund in 1932, initially as a producer of wooden bricks for children, but nearly a century later, the company is still growing year-on-year; in 2025, they posted record revenues of over $12bn, with an operating profit of $3.2bn.
